prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Mamta didi, Subhash bhai, Prakash bhai, Subhash N..
The chat covers 14/04/26, 8:30 pm to 14/04/26, 10:30 pm. It must have exactly 22 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
14/04/26, 9:39 pm - Subhash bhai: Prakash bhai, ye entry abhi delete kar do, kisi ko mat batana
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
Fix these problems from your previous attempt:
- F1: chat.txt:11 at 9:24 pm vs calls.csv row 3 at 21:38 differs by 14 min (tolerance 2)
text:
14/04/26, 8:32 pm - Mamta didi: Aaj shaam ka cash counter tally ho gaya kya sabka?

14/04/26, 8:45 pm - Subhash N.: Mera bhi complete hai, bas ek 5000 ka UPI transfer pending dikha raha hai system me.
14/04/26, 8:52 pm - Subhash bhai: Wo 5000 wala payment customer ne do baar try kiya tha, system issue tha lagta hai.
14/04/26, 9:01 pm - Mamta didi: Subhash bhai, unverified UPI entries ko flag karna zaroori hai audit ke liye.
14/04/26, 9:08 pm - Prakash bhai: Main register me note kar raha hoon, UTR number match kar lete hain pehle.
14/04/26, 9:15 pm - Subhash N.: Maine customer ko call kiya tha, wo bol rahe hain unke account se money deduct ho gaya hai.
14/04/26, 9:22 pm - Subhash bhai: Direct backend se verification lene ki zarurat nahi hai, main handle kar lunga.
14/04/26, 9:29 pm - Mamta didi: Subhash N., tum audit sheet me tentative write-off mat daalna bina approval ke.
14/04/26, 9:34 pm - Subhash N.: Thik hai didi, main Prakash bhai ko manual ledger entry verify karne ko keh raha hoon.
14/04/26, 9:38 pm - Prakash bhai: Subhash bhai, ye wala suspicious trans ID system me match nahi ho raha hai.
14/04/26, 9:39 pm - Subhash bhai: Prakash bhai, ye entry abhi delete kar do, kisi ko mat batana
14/04/26, 9:43 pm - Prakash bhai: Par bhai, bina manager consent ke main manual entry kaise delete karoon?
14/04/26, 9:48 pm - Mamta didi: Kya chal raha hai tum dono ke beech? Kuch mismatch mil gaya kya ledger me?
14/04/26, 9:54 pm - Subhash N.: Mujhe lagta hai kisi suspicious link se scan karke fake approval create hua hai.
14/04/26, 10:01 pm - Subhash bhai: Kuch nahi Mamta didi, bas ek duplicate transaction tag tha, sort out ho gaya.
14/04/26, 10:07 pm - Prakash bhai: Main log report manager ko forward kar raha hoon, verification zaroori hai.
14/04/26, 10:12 pm - Mamta didi: Sahi kiya Prakash, koi bhi discrepancy ho toh fraud prevention team ko inform karo.
14/04/26, 10:18 pm - Subhash N.: Haan, IT security portal par ticket raise kar diya hai main transaction ID ka.
14/04/26, 10:23 pm - Subhash bhai: Arey ticket kyu raise kiya, pehle internal discuss kar lete hum sab.
14/04/26, 10:27 pm - Prakash bhai: Rules clear hain bhai, safety check skip nahi kar sakte.
14/04/26, 10:30 pm - Mamta didi: Kal morning meeting me sabhi system logs analyze karenge, chat closed for tonight.
